_comment: GCP cluster configuration settings applied during job import. Edit this file to customise target workspace behaviour.

workspace_excludes._comment: Regex patterns applied during staging. Objects/paths matching ANY pattern in each list are skipped.

user_domain_mapping._comment: Rename email domains globally. Key = source domain suffix, value = target domain. Applied AFTER user_id_mapping.

user_id_mapping._comment: Explicit source-to-target user remapping. Takes precedence over user_domain_mapping. Key = source email/ID, value = target email.

gcp_attributes._comment: Fallback GCP attributes injected when the source Azure cluster has no explicit availability setting. The 'availability' field is auto-mapped from azure_attributes: ON_DEMAND_AZURE→ON_DEMAND_GCP | SPOT_AZURE→PREEMPTIBLE_GCP | SPOT_WITH_FALLBACK_AZURE→SPOT_WITH_FALLBACK_GCP. Set here only as the default when Azure has no azure_attributes.

gcp_attributes_optional._comment: Uncomment / set google_service_account if your cluster needs GCS access via a service account.

cluster_name_transforms._comment: Applied to cluster_name and creator_user_name fields in every cluster spec.

job_name_suffix._comment: The migrate tool appends :::JOB_ID to job names.  Set strip_id_suffix=true to remove it.

schedule_behaviour._comment: Imported jobs' schedules are set to PAUSED by default to avoid unintended runs in target.

email_notifications._comment: Set clear_on_import=true to strip all email notification addresses from imported jobs.

all_purpose_cluster_options._comment: Options applied to all-purpose (interactive) cluster records during staging. Does NOT affect job clusters or instance pools.
all_purpose_cluster_options._remove_acls_comment: true = wipe access_control_list entries in acl_clusters.log to a clean slate (only built-in admins group kept).
all_purpose_cluster_options._remove_libraries_comment: true = strip the 'libraries' array from every all-purpose cluster record.
all_purpose_cluster_options._remove_sas_tokens_comment: true = drop spark_conf keys that look like Azure SAS/account-key configs (*.azure.*, *.wasb.*, *.abfs.*, *.dfs.core.windows.net, *.blob.core.windows.net).

gcp_spark_config._enabled_comment: Master toggle for GCP spark config rewriting.
gcp_spark_config._azure_comment: Drop all spark_conf keys referencing Azure storage (fs.azure.*, spark.hadoop.fs.azure.*, wasb://, abfss://).
gcp_spark_config._aws_comment: Drop all spark_conf keys referencing AWS (fs.s3.*, spark.hadoop.fs.s3*, etc.).

inject._comment: Key-value pairs injected into spark_conf of every all-purpose cluster. Leave empty to inject nothing.
